data.name: Complete Physical Examination

code.decode: Office or other outpatient visit, established patient

data.label: Complete Physical Exam
data.description: Full physical examination excluding pelvic, rectal, and breast examinations unless clinically indicated. Includes assessment for TB risk factors and signs/symptoms of active TB including peripheral lymph nodes.

data.name: Symptom-Directed Physical Assessment

code.decode: Office or other outpatient visit, established patient

data.label: Symptom-Directed Exam
data.description: Includes examination of eyes, throat, heart, lungs, abdomen, and visual examination of the skin. Includes assessment for TB risk factors and signs/symptoms of active TB including peripheral lymph nodes.

data.name: Vital Signs Measurement

code.decode: Office or other outpatient visit, minimal

data.label: Vital Signs
data.description: Measurement of pulse rate, blood pressure, respiratory rate, and body temperature.

data.name: 12-Lead Electrocardiogram

code.decode: Electrocardiogram, routine ECG with at least 12 leads

data.label: ECG 12-Lead
data.description: Single, local 12-lead electrocardiogram performed at screening, Week 2, and Week 12 of Study Period 1, and at early discontinuation if prior to Week 12.

data.name: Chest X-Ray

code.decode: Radiologic examination, chest; 2 views

data.label: Chest X-Ray
data.description: Posterior-anterior view chest x-ray and lateral view if needed, performed locally, interpreted and reported by a radiologist or pulmonologist. Used for TB evaluation. A chest CT scan can be used instead.

data.name: Chest CT Scan

code.decode: Computed tomography, thorax; without contrast material

data.label: Chest CT
data.description: Computed tomography of the chest, used as an alternative to chest x-ray for TB evaluation within the same time window.

data.name: Dual-Energy X-Ray Absorptiometry Scan

code.decode: Dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry (DXA), bone density study, 1 or more sites

data.label: DXA Scan
data.description: DXA scan performed for bone density assessment. Radiation exposure (effective dose) of approximately 5 μSv or 0.005 mSv. Performed at unscheduled visits and early discontinuation if during Study Period 1.

data.name: Endoscopy with Biopsy

code.decode: Colonoscopy through stoma; with biopsy, single or multiple

data.label: Endoscopy with Biopsy
data.description: Endoscopy performed on all participants during screening within 21 days before randomization and at Week 12 of Study Period 1. A second endoscopy is allowed if inadequate preparation or equipment issues. Colonic tissue biopsies obtained for exploratory biomarkers.

data.name: Venipuncture / Blood Sample Collection

code.decode: Collection of venous blood by venipuncture

data.label: Blood Draw
data.description: Collection of venous blood samples for hematology, clinical chemistry, coagulation, lipids, serum pregnancy, FSH, PTH, serum 25-hydroxy vitamin D, P1NP, CTX-1, bone-specific ALP, HBV DNA, HCV, HIV, pharmacokinetics, pharmacodynamics, immunogenicity, and exploratory biomarker assessments.

data.name: Urine Collection

code.decode: Urinalysis, by dip stick or tablet reagent

data.label: Urine Sample Collection
data.description: Collection of urine samples for urinalysis and urine pregnancy testing.

data.name: Stool Sample Collection

code.decode: Sputum obtaining specimen, aerosol induced technique

data.label: Stool Collection
data.description: Collection of stool samples for fecal calprotectin testing, C. difficile testing, stool culture, ova and parasites testing, and exploratory biomarker stool supernatant collection.

data.name: Tuberculosis Skin Test (TST/PPD)

code.decode: Skin test, tuberculosis, intradermal

data.label: TB Skin Test
data.description: Tuberculin skin test (purified protein derivative). Participants return 48 to 72 hours after placement to have results read. Must be read by a trained medical professional.

data.name: Hematology Laboratory Tests

code.decode: Blood count; complete (CBC), automated (Hgb, Hct, RBC, WBC and platelet count) and automated differential WBC count

data.label: Hematology
data.description: Clinical safety laboratory hematology tests performed at multiple visits throughout the study.

data.name: Clinical Chemistry Laboratory Tests

code.decode: Comprehensive metabolic panel

data.label: Clinical Chemistry
data.description: Clinical safety laboratory chemistry tests performed at multiple visits throughout the study.

data.name: Coagulation Tests

code.decode: Prothrombin time

data.label: Coagulation
data.description: Coagulation laboratory tests performed at screening.

data.name: Fasting Lipid Panel

code.decode: Lipid panel

data.label: Lipids (Fasting)
data.description: Fasting lipid panel performed at baseline (Week 0) and Week 12 of Study Period 1.

data.name: Serum Pregnancy Test

code.decode: Gonadotropin, chorionic (hCG); quantitative

data.label: Serum Pregnancy Test
data.description: Serum pregnancy test for individuals of childbearing potential (IOCBP) at screening.

data.name: Urine Pregnancy Test

code.decode: Urine pregnancy test, by visual color comparison methods

data.label: Urine Pregnancy Test
data.description: Urine pregnancy test for IOCBP; negative test required prior to dosing at marked visits. In Study Period 1, done on site only. In Study Period 2, can be done on-site or at home.

data.name: Follicle-Stimulating Hormone Test

code.decode: Follicle stimulating hormone (FSH)

data.label: FSH Test
data.description: Optional FSH test to confirm postmenopausal status in individuals assigned female at birth (AFAB).

data.name: HIV Testing

code.decode: Antibody; HIV-1 and HIV-2, single result

data.label: HIV Test
data.description: HIV testing performed at screening.

data.name: Hepatitis B Virus Screening

code.decode: Infectious agent antigen detection by immunoassay technique, hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg)

data.label: HBV Screening
data.description: Hepatitis B virus screening including HBsAg and anti-HBc. If HBsAg is negative and anti-HBc is positive, further testing for HBV DNA is required.

data.name: Hepatitis B Virus DNA Testing

code.decode: Infectious agent detection by nucleic acid (DNA or RNA); Hepatitis B virus, quantitative

data.label: HBV DNA Test
data.description: HBV DNA testing for participants who are anti-HBc positive at screening, performed at multiple visits throughout the study.

data.name: Hepatitis C Virus Screening

code.decode: Hepatitis C antibody

data.label: HCV Screening
data.description: Hepatitis C virus antibody screening. If HCV Ab test is positive, perform HCV RNA test.

data.name: Urinalysis

code.decode: Urinalysis, by dip stick or tablet reagent for bilirubin, glucose, hemoglobin, ketones, leukocytes, nitrite, pH, protein, specific gravity, and urobilinogen; with microscopy

data.label: Urinalysis
data.description: Urinalysis performed at screening.

data.name: C-Reactive Protein (High Sensitivity) Test

code.decode: C-reactive protein; high sensitivity (hsCRP)

data.label: hsCRP
data.description: High sensitivity C-reactive protein blood test performed at multiple visits in Study Period 2.

data.name: Parathyroid Hormone Test

code.decode: Parathormone (parathyroid hormone)

data.label: PTH
data.description: Parathyroid hormone blood test performed at baseline and Week 12 of Study Period 1, and at Week 40 of Study Period 2.

data.name: Serum 25-Hydroxy Vitamin D Test

code.decode: Vitamin D; 25 hydroxy, includes fraction(s), if performed

data.label: Vitamin D Test
data.description: Serum 25-hydroxy vitamin D test performed at Week 40 of Study Period 2.

data.name: Procollagen Type I N-Propeptide Test

code.decode: Unlisted immunology procedure

data.label: P1NP
data.description: P1NP bone formation marker blood test performed at Week 40 of Study Period 2.

data.name: C-Terminal Telopeptide Test

code.decode: Collagen cross links, any method

data.label: CTX-1
data.description: CTX-1 bone resorption marker blood test performed at Week 40 of Study Period 2.

data.name: Bone-Specific Alkaline Phosphatase Test

code.decode: Immunoassay for analyte other than antibody or infectious agent antigen, quantitative

data.label: Bone-Specific ALP
data.description: Bone-specific alkaline phosphatase blood test performed at Week 40 of Study Period 2.

data.name: Fecal Calprotectin Test

code.decode: Calprotectin, fecal

data.label: Fecal Calprotectin
data.description: Stool test for fecal calprotectin performed at multiple visits. Stool supernatant from the same sample is also used for exploratory biomarkers.

data.name: Clostridium difficile Testing

code.decode: Infectious agent detection by nucleic acid (DNA or RNA); Clostridium difficile, toxin gene(s), amplified probe technique

data.label: C. difficile Test
data.description: Stool test for C. difficile performed at Week 16 of Study Period 2. Additional testing allowed throughout the study at investigator's discretion.

data.name: Stool Culture

code.decode: Culture, bacterial; stool, aerobic, with isolation and presumptive identification of isolates

data.label: Stool Culture
data.description: Stool culture performed at Week 16 of Study Period 2. Additional testing allowed throughout the study at investigator's discretion. Other local stool testing (e.g., ova and parasites) allowed at investigator's discretion.

data.name: Genetics Sample Collection

code.decode: Collection of venous blood by venipuncture

data.label: Genetics Sample
data.description: Blood sample collected for genetics analysis. Collected at or after Visit 2 (Week 0) if country regulations allow.

data.name: Exploratory Biomarker Blood Sample Collection

code.decode: Collection of venous blood by venipuncture

data.label: Exploratory Biomarker Blood
data.description: Blood samples collected for exploratory biomarker analysis at multiple visits in Study Period 1 and Study Period 2.

data.name: Exploratory Biomarker Stool Supernatant Collection

code.decode: Sputum obtaining specimen, aerosol induced technique

data.label: Exploratory Biomarker Stool
data.description: Stool supernatant collected from the same stool sample used for fecal calprotectin testing for exploratory biomarker analysis.

data.name: Exploratory Biomarker Colonic Tissue Collection

code.decode: Colonoscopy through stoma; with biopsy, single or multiple

data.label: Colonic Tissue Biopsy
data.description: Colonic tissue samples obtained from endoscopic biopsy at screening and Week 12 of Study Period 1 for exploratory biomarker analysis.

data.name: Mirikizumab Intravenous Infusion

code.decode: Chemotherapy administration, intravenous infusion technique; up to 1 hour, single or initial substance/drug

data.label: Mirikizumab IV Infusion
data.description: Intravenous administration of mirikizumab performed on-site at Weeks 0, 4, and 8 of Study Period 1.

data.name: Mirikizumab Subcutaneous Injection

code.decode: Therapeutic, prophylactic, or diagnostic injection; subcutaneous or intramuscular

data.label: Mirikizumab SC Injection
data.description: Subcutaneous administration of mirikizumab starting at Week 0 of Study Period 2 for responders. Initial administration on-site; subsequent doses can be self-administered off-site by participant or caregiver after training.

data.name: Crohn's Disease Activity Index Assessment

code.decode: Office or other outpatient visit, established patient

data.label: CDAI Assessment
data.description: Assessment of Crohn's Disease Activity Index. Patient-reported items recorded daily via eDiary; clinician-reported items recorded at specified site visits.

data.name: Fistula Evaluation

code.decode: Office or other outpatient visit, established patient

data.label: Fistula Evaluation
data.description: Evaluation for existing perianal fistulas (if present at baseline) and for any newly developed fistulas, performed at multiple visits in Study Period 1.

data.name: Depression and Suicidal Ideation and Behavior Risk Monitoring

code.decode: Brief emotional/behavioral assessment

data.label: Depression/Suicidality Monitoring
data.description: Monitoring for depression and suicidal ideation and behavior risk using Columbia Suicide-Severity Rating Scale (C-SSRS) and Quick Inventory for Depressive Symptomatology - Self Report 16 items (QIDS-SR16).

data.name: Pharmacokinetic Sample Collection

code.decode: Collection of venous blood by venipuncture

data.label: PK Sample Collection
data.description: Blood samples collected for pharmacokinetic analysis of LY4395089 and mirikizumab.

data.name: Immunogenicity Assessment

code.decode: Collection of venous blood by venipuncture

data.label: Immunogenicity
data.description: Blood samples collected for immunogenicity assessments (anti-drug antibody testing) for LY4395089 and mirikizumab.

data.name: Injection/Infusion Site Reaction Assessment

code.decode: Office or other outpatient visit, established patient

data.label: ISR Assessment
data.description: Monitoring and assessment of injection and infusion site reactions.

data.name: Hypersensitivity Reaction Assessment

code.decode: Office or other outpatient visit, established patient

data.label: Hypersensitivity Assessment
data.description: Assessment and monitoring for hypersensitivity reactions. Laboratory samples to be obtained at the time of systemic hypersensitivity reaction.

data.name: Hepatic Safety Monitoring

code.decode: Hepatic function panel

data.label: Hepatic Safety Monitoring
data.description: Hepatic safety monitoring, evaluation, and criteria for study drug interruption or discontinuation.

data.name: Height Measurement

code.decode: Office or other outpatient visit, established patient

data.label: Height
data.description: Height measurement performed at screening.

data.name: Weight Measurement

code.decode: Office or other outpatient visit, established patient

data.label: Weight
data.description: Weight measurement performed at multiple visits throughout the study.

data.name: Simple Endoscopic Score for Crohn's Disease Assessment

code.decode: Colonoscopy through stoma; with biopsy, single or multiple

data.label: SES-CD
data.description: Endoscopic assessment using the Simple Endoscopic Score for Crohn's Disease (SES-CD) during endoscopy procedures.

data.name: Histological Scoring

code.decode: Level IV - Surgical pathology, gross and microscopic examination

data.label: Histological Assessment
data.description: Histological scoring of biopsy samples obtained during endoscopy.

data.name: Urinary Albumin/Creatinine Ratio

code.decode: Albumin; urine, microalbumin, quantitative

data.label: UACR
data.description: Urinary albumin/creatinine ratio measurement.

data.name: Prefilled Syringe
data.label: PFS
data.description: Prefilled syringe used for subcutaneous self-administration of mirikizumab by participant or caregiver after appropriate training. Initial administration on-site under supervision; subsequent doses can be administered off-site.

data.name: Electronic Diary (eDiary)
data.label: eDiary
data.description: Electronic diary used by participants to record daily patient-reported outcomes including CDAI stool frequency, CDAI abdominal pain, CDAI general well-being, and bowel movement count. Applicable to Study Period 1 and early discontinuation if during Study Period 1.

data.name: Interactive Web-Response System
data.label: IWRS
data.description: Interactive web-response system used for visit registration, randomization or assignment to ISA, and randomization to study intervention.

data.name: Genetics Sample Retention
data.description: A genetics blood sample is collected at or after Visit 2 (Week 0) if country regulations allow, and is stored. The protocol references a dedicated Genetics appendix (Appendix 5), indicating these samples are retained for genetic analysis. Country-specific regulations govern collection and retention.

data.name: Exploratory Biomarker Sample Retention
data.description: Exploratory biomarker samples (blood, stool supernatant, and colonic tissue from endoscopic biopsy) are collected and stored at multiple visits throughout the study for future exploratory research purposes.
